data.long_meaning: Derived from the German word 'Boelter', meaning 'brave warrior'. Historically, this name was given to children born into warrior families or those destined for military careers. The name Boelter carries the meaning “Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Boelter usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
